image.alt: The Mundy's Automotive shop on Williston Road

body: At Mundy's Automotive we specialize in the service and repair of all automotive vehicles, semi-trucks, trailers and RVs. We also provide expert service on a wide variety of farm and commercial equipment, hydraulic hoses and cylinders.

Our ASE certified technicians are highly skilled, with years of experience, and use the latest diagnostic technology to deliver high-quality work and a quick turnaround. As a certified NAPA Truck Service Center, we can do everything from complete semi and trailer rebuilds to replacing pumps and blowers or installing new brakes and tires.
